proposal.reason: Main change removes CollNet execution from network transport/plugin/proxy paths (including CollNet backend loading, connect/proxy resources, and transport hooks). Additional substantive changes remove CollNet device-kernel implementations and reserved function-table behavior handling (kernels), delete CollNet topology graph construction/search/connection logic (graph-search), hard-disable the CollNet algorithm slot while preserving IDs and updating model-based/tuner fallback selection rules (tuning), and update runtime algo/protocol validation, chunking/pattern selection, and channel scheduling in collective planning (enqueue).
